messages:
leah (Billing): Team update: new per-minute quota smoothing and change to free credit expiration policy. Effective 2025-01-15 UTC. Please review.

leah (Billing): Key points:
- Minute smoothing: we’re changing from strict per-minute hard caps to a sliding-window smoothing of 60s with burst tolerance computed over 5-minute windows.
- Free credit expiry: free credits will now expire at account anniversary instead of 30 days after grant. New accounts created after launch will still get a 90-day phased allowance.

evAN (EngInfra): Technical: smoothing is implemented in the gatekeeper service; config flag `smoothingWindow=300s` and `burstTolerance=1.25`. Default for existing accounts: smoothing enabled.

sophia (Finance): Invoice changes: we will consolidate small credit lines into `free_credit_adjustments` to reduce invoice clutter. This will roll out in the March billing cycle following launch.

mike (Support): Need a short explainer for customers who see different throttling behavior. Also monitor for any increase in latency of rejections.

notify-bot: Docs scheduled for 2024-12-20. Customer email scheduled for 2025-01-05.

leah (Billing): Action items: @evan update gatekeeper config + migration, @sophia confirm accounting mapping, @mike draft support doc, @leah finalize blog post.

evAN (EngInfra): Will add flags to support rolling back within 48 hours if we see regressions.

sophia (Finance): Confirmed: consolidated invoice lines will be backward compatible with CSV mapping.

mike (Support): Drafted the FAQ, will post in help channel for review.

leah (Billing): Thanks — keep issues here.
